posts.text: Attention! I'm joining Attention Inc. as a Software Engineer intern this winter! Attention is a venture-backed, early-stage startup in Palo Alto, California, building AI products that observe how knowledge workers and teams actually work and turn those workflows into reliable automations. Aidan Guo & Julian Windeck - thank you for the smooth process and looking forward to working with you all soon! If you're in Palo Alto this winter, feel free to reach out!

Calling all students: apply to Hack the North! This year, I'm organizing logistics for HTN, and if there's one thing I learned, it's to try new things and just do it. I know most of you are passionate builders; HTN is truly the place to pour your lifetime of craftsmanship into a weekend of excitement, learning, and empowerment. Think you don't have a place at the event? Don't worry, that's what 90% of hackers think when they apply; chances are, you are underestimating yourself. Press that apply

Only problem is, AI agents and API costs are often ignored. You only realize the mistake once you check your bank account.
